entries.zh: 打边（而）来；从旁边过来〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to come by / from the side (entry damaged; doubtful)
entries.notes: 汉字'人'半没墨渍且 M 栏三音节声调均污损（T99），'人'字句法角色未定，仅据 L'por el lado'与'打邊'推为'靠边来'。

entries.zh: 白白来；空手而来、分文不带（白来一趟）
entries.en: to come empty-handed, without a farthing (sin blanca)

entries.zh: 无物来；空手而来、不带任何东西（'白白来'之另说）
entries.en: to come with nothing, empty-handed

entries.zh: 相同舡（的人）来；同乘一船渡来
entries.en: to come in one boatload, all in the same boat (barcada)

entries.zh: 头头来；最先来到、打头而来
entries.en: to come first, be the first to arrive

entries.zh: 先来；先于他人而来（'头头来'之另说）
entries.en: to come first / before others

entries.zh: 迢递（远道）而来；专程为某事前来
entries.en: to come on purpose / expressly for something, from afar

entries.zh: 迢迢而来；远道而来（上条之另说）
entries.en: to come from afar (variant of the preceding)

entries.zh: 迢来拜；远道前来拜见、行礼致敬（或归顺）
entries.en: to come from afar to pay homage / render obeisance

entries.zh: 〔语义无法定夺，疑为'节节／分批而来'〕
entries.en: uncertain; possibly 'to come piece by piece / in batches'
entries.notes: 西语词头'ross en vno'疑有涂误、汉字'邵／郊'存疑，'chat chat'与两栏均难互证，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 径直而来；一直前来〔汉字'序／存'存疑〕
entries.en: to come straight / directly
entries.notes: 汉字'序／存'与罗马字首字母 z/ç 均有存疑标记，义项据西语 derecho（径直）推定。

entries.zh: 〔释义存疑：疑为一伙成群（cuadrilla）而来〕
entries.en: uncertain; possibly 'to come as a band / in a group (cuadrilla)'
entries.notes: 西语'quadriglla y ora'疑为 cuadrilla 之讹且句法难解，汉字'存存'与音 chun chun 无法与词义互证。

entries.zh: 益来；愈来愈多地来、此后来者更多〔首字母存疑〕
entries.en: to come more and more; many more coming afterwards
entries.notes: 词头'despues muchos'（其后多人）与'益'（愈、增益）义相合，惟罗马字首字母 e/ç 存疑。

entries.zh: 慌忙而来；仓促突然地来
entries.en: to come hurriedly / unexpectedly (de improviso)
entries.notes: 词头缩写 improviss.（improviso／improvistos）之展开依赖推断，故降中置信。

entries.zh: 慌狂而来；惊慌失措、慌乱奔来（上条之变体）
entries.en: to come in a panic / frantic haste
entries.notes: 承上条 improviss. 之存疑；'慌狂'（惊慌狂乱）与突发慌乱义相合。

entries.zh: 因祸得福；善由恶来、祸中生福〔原件第二行残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: good to come out of evil; blessing gained through misfortune
entries.notes: 主行'Venir el bien por el mal'与'因祸得福'互证清晰，惟西语第二行涂改残缺（疑 natural…ab extra），依残损例降为低置信。

entries.zh: 馆；客栈旅舍，可供投宿
entries.en: inn, guesthouse; lodging, to put up (aposentarse)
entries.notes: 西语首字母有存疑标记 [疑:s/r]；'venta'（17 世纪官道客店）与'馆'义合，'aposentarse'（投宿）据词头语境推定。

entries.zh: 驿；驿站、官设驿馆（递传歇驻之所）
entries.en: post station; official courier relay inn (of the mandarins)

entries.zh: 食驿；就食于驿站、在驿馆用饭
entries.en: to take meals at the post station; eat at the relay inn

entries.zh: 公驿；官驿、公办驿馆
entries.en: official (public) post station

entries.zh: 五里亭；每五里一设的路亭驿亭（行人歇脚处）
entries.en: five-li pavilion; wayside rest pavilion set at every five li (cf. a venta at every five leagues)
